intro: The Terrace of Repose is a pristine courtyard garden located just outside the entrance to the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Maintained by the Scarlet Crusade, it stands as one of the few places in northern Lordaeron completely untouched by the Plague of Undeath, complete with green hedges and clean water.

p: Situated just north of the grand entrance into the Scarlet Monastery, the Terrace of Repose offers a surreal contrast to the rotting forests of Tirisfal Glades. While the rest of Lordaeron chokes under grey mist, corrupt soil, and stagnant bogs, this terrace boasts verdant, neatly pruned hedges and a functioning fountain fed by fresh, uncontaminated water. For the zealots of the Scarlet Crusade, the garden serves as physical proof of their divine righteousness and purity, a sacred bastion demonstrating that holy devotion can ward off the Scourge's corruption.
